Name: Rambunctious Reindeer
Author: nugmods
Description:
My original sprites for Mizu's Reindeer, inspired heavily by the artistic styles of Siamece, Cajcbell, and Kwillow! Covers all the default and extra reindeer skins and babies, too! Because who doesn't want some fuzzy, frosty babies in their barns <3

[b]Install:[/b]
Just put it in your mods folder, I promise it's that easy

[b]Credits:[/b]
Artistic Inspiration:  Siamece, Cajcbell, and Kwillow, whose animal textures I use in my own game, and thus these sprites are designed to match
Mizu: for the Reindeer mod <3
Technical Assistance: Selph, for helping me figure out how to patch to the spooky and intimidating internalassetkeys
